thought.text: Dev server is up and responding with HTTP 200. Let me verify the page content and then stop the dev server:

reasoning_content: The dev server is running. Let's quickly check the content of the response, and also verify that the built static files are being served correctly. After that, we'll stop the dev server to keep the environment in a clean state.

action.command: curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' | head -2; grep -c '<title>' /workspace/out/index.html; kill 845 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next dev" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "after kill: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/ 2>/dev/null || echo "server stopped"
